text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
For inheritance, their “compatibility” is 
determined by the relationship between 
the trained horsegirl and her successors.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
If they have good compatibility, 
you're a little more likely to have 
good things happen to them!
color_text_info_list: a little bit of good luck

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
You may want to keep this in mind as a 
reference for future combinations! ♪
